dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: This clothes shop was opened by Ms. Chiori, a renowned Inazuman designer.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: She has gained great favor in Fontaine's fashion world by incorporating elements of "resistance" and "revolution" into her designs.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: I know this sounds like tooting one's own horn, but it is no exaggeration to say that Ms. Chiori has sparked a real fashion craze here in our nation.
